21	@pytest.fixture
22	def collection(tmp_path):
23	    schema = zvec.CollectionSchema(
24	        "validation", fields=zvec.FieldSchema("text", zvec.DataType.STRING)
25	    )
26	    coll = zvec.create_and_open(str(tmp_path / "collection"), schema)
27	    try:
28	        yield coll

33	@pytest.mark.parametrize("name", ["x", "ab", "集合 / 2026 🔎", "集" * 85 + "a"])
34	def test_collection_names_round_trip(tmp_path, name):
35	    path = str(tmp_path / "collection")
36	    schema = zvec.CollectionSchema(
37	        name, fields=zvec.FieldSchema("text", zvec.DataType.STRING)
38	    )
39	    coll = zvec.create_and_open(path, schema)
40	    try:
41	        assert coll.schema.name == name
42	        coll.close()
43	        coll = zvec.open(path)
44	        assert coll.schema.name == name
45	    finally:
46	        coll.close()
47

49	def test_document_ids_round_trip_without_normalization(collection):
50	    ids = [
51	        "user:123",
52	        "https://example.com/articles/42?a=b",
53	        "订单-2026-🙂",
54	        "界" * 341 + "a",  # 1024 UTF-8 bytes.
55	        "doc",
56	        " doc",
57	        "doc ",
58	        " ",
59	        "é",
60	        "e\u0301",
61	    ]
62	    text = "正文\nsecond line\tvalue"
63	    statuses = collection.insert(
64	        [zvec.Doc(id=doc_id, fields={"text": text}) for doc_id in ids]
65	    )
66	    assert all(status.ok() for status in statuses)
67	    collection.flush()
68	    fetched = collection.fetch(ids)
69	    assert set(fetched) == set(ids)
70	    for doc_id in ids:
71	        assert fetched[doc_id].id == doc_id
72	        assert fetched[doc_id].field("text") == text
73	
74	
75	@pytest.mark.parametrize("operation", ["insert", "update", "upsert"])
76	@pytest.mark.parametrize(
77	    "doc_id,reason",
78	    [
79	        ("", "must not be empty"),
80	        ("doc\0id", "null character"),
81	        ("doc\nid", "newline"),
82	        ("界" * 341 + "ab", "exceeds 1024 bytes (got 1025)"),
83	        (b"\xff", "not valid UTF-8"),
84	        ("\ud800", "not valid UTF-8"),
85	    ],
86	)
87	def test_invalid_id_rejects_batch_before_writing(collection, operation, doc_id, reason):
88	    if operation == "update":
89	        assert collection.insert(zvec.Doc("valid", fields={"text": "before"})).ok()
90	
91	    docs = [
92	        zvec.Doc("valid", fields={"text": "after"}),
93	        zvec.Doc(doc_id, fields={"text": "invalid"}),
94	    ]
95	    with pytest.raises(ValueError) as exc_info:
96	        getattr(collection, operation)(docs)
97	
98	    message = str(exc_info.value)
99	    assert message.startswith("Invalid doc:")
100	    assert reason in message
101	    assert "document at index" not in message
102	    assert "offset" not in message
103	    if doc_id:
104	        assert "id[" in message
105	    assert "\n" not in message
106	    assert "\0" not in message
107	    fetched = collection.fetch("valid")
108	    if operation == "update":
109	        assert fetched["valid"].field("text") == "before"
110	    else:
111	        assert fetched == {}
112

114	@pytest.mark.parametrize("operation", ["insert", "update", "upsert"])
115	def test_conversion_type_error_rejects_batch_before_writing(collection, operation):
116	    if operation == "update":
117	        assert collection.insert(zvec.Doc("valid", fields={"text": "before"})).ok()
118	
119	    docs = [
120	        zvec.Doc("valid", fields={"text": "after"}),
121	        zvec.Doc("invalid", fields={"text": 42}),
122	    ]
123	    with pytest.raises(TypeError) as exc_info:
124	        getattr(collection, operation)(docs)
125	
126	    message = str(exc_info.value)
127	    assert "Field 'text': expected STRING" in message
128	    assert "document at index" not in message
129	    fetched = collection.fetch("valid")
130	    if operation == "update":
131	        assert fetched["valid"].field("text") == "before"
132	    else:
133	        assert fetched == {}

136	@pytest.mark.parametrize(
137	    "name,reason",
138	    [
139	        ("", "must not be empty"),
140	        ("collection\0name", "null character"),
141	        ("collection\nname", "newline"),
142	        ("集" * 86, "exceeds 256 bytes (got 258)"),
143	    ],
144	)
145	def test_invalid_collection_names_report_the_reason(tmp_path, name, reason):
146	    schema = zvec.CollectionSchema(
147	        name, fields=zvec.FieldSchema("text", zvec.DataType.STRING)
148	    )
149	    with pytest.raises(ValueError) as exc_info:
150	        zvec.create_and_open(str(tmp_path / "collection"), schema)
151	    message = str(exc_info.value)
152	    assert message.startswith("Invalid schema:")
153	    assert "collection name" in message
154	    assert reason in message
155	    assert "offset" not in message
156	    if name:
157	        assert "collection name[" in message
158	    assert "\n" not in message
159	    assert "\0" not in message
160

162	@pytest.mark.parametrize(
163	    "doc_id,preview",
164	    [
165	        ("order\n[123]", r"order\n\[123\]"),
166	        (b"\xff", r"\xFF"),
167	        ("x" * 1025, "x" * 32 + "..."),
168	    ],
169	)
170	def test_id_error_includes_safe_preview(collection, doc_id, preview):
171	    with pytest.raises(ValueError) as exc_info:
172	        collection.insert(zvec.Doc(doc_id, fields={"text": "value"}))
173	    assert f"Invalid doc: id[{preview}]" in str(exc_info.value)

176	def test_long_field_name_and_rejected_rename_preserve_data(tmp_path):
177	    field_name = "f" * 64
178	    schema = zvec.CollectionSchema(
179	        "fields", fields=zvec.FieldSchema(field_name, zvec.DataType.INT32)
180	    )
181	    coll = zvec.create_and_open(str(tmp_path / "collection"), schema)
182	    try:
183	        assert coll.insert(zvec.Doc("doc", fields={field_name: 42})).ok()
184	        with pytest.raises(ValueError) as exc_info:
185	            coll.alter_column(field_name, new_name="f" * 65)
186	        message = str(exc_info.value)
187	        assert message.startswith("Invalid schema:")
188	        assert "exceeds 64 bytes (got 65)" in message
189	        assert "offset" not in message
190	        assert coll.schema.field(field_name) is not None
191	        assert coll.fetch("doc")["doc"].field(field_name) == 42
192	    finally:
193	        coll.destroy()

196	@pytest.mark.parametrize("operation", ["insert", "update", "upsert"])
197	def test_surrogate_id_has_a_readable_encoding_error(collection, operation):
198	    with pytest.raises(
199	        ValueError,
200	        match="^" + re.escape(r"Invalid doc: id['\ud800'] is not valid UTF-8") + "$",
201	    ):
202	        getattr(collection, operation)(zvec.Doc("\ud800", fields={"text": "value"}))
203	    assert collection.stats.doc_count == 0

206	@pytest.mark.parametrize("kind", ["collection", "field", "vector"])
207	def test_surrogate_schema_name_has_a_readable_encoding_error(kind):
208	    with pytest.raises(
209	        ValueError, match="^Invalid schema: .* is not valid UTF-8$"
210	    ) as exc_info:
211	        if kind == "collection":
212	            zvec.CollectionSchema("\ud800")
213	        elif kind == "field":
214	            zvec.FieldSchema("\ud800", zvec.DataType.INT32)
215	        else:
216	            zvec.VectorSchema("\ud800", zvec.DataType.VECTOR_FP32, dimension=2)
217	    assert r"['\ud800']" in str(exc_info.value)
218

220	@pytest.mark.parametrize("invalid", [0, False, [], {}, b""])
221	@pytest.mark.parametrize("argument", ["new_name", "field_schema"])
222	def test_falsey_alter_arguments_are_not_silently_ignored(tmp_path, invalid, argument):
223	    schema = zvec.CollectionSchema(
224	        "fields", fields=zvec.FieldSchema("value", zvec.DataType.INT32)
225	    )
226	    coll = zvec.create_and_open(str(tmp_path / "collection"), schema)
227	    try:
228	        assert coll.insert(zvec.Doc("doc", fields={"value": 42})).ok()
229	        kwargs = (
230	            {
231	                "new_name": invalid,
232	                "field_schema": zvec.FieldSchema("renamed", zvec.DataType.INT32),
233	            }
234	            if argument == "new_name"
235	            else {"new_name": "renamed", "field_schema": invalid}
236	        )
237	        with pytest.raises(TypeError, match="^Invalid schema:"):
238	            coll.alter_column("value", **kwargs)
239	        assert coll.schema.field("value") is not None
240	        assert coll.schema.field("renamed") is None
241	        assert coll.fetch("doc")["doc"].field("value") == 42
242	    finally:
243	        coll.destroy()
244	
245	
246	@pytest.mark.parametrize("kind", ["field", "vector"])
247	@pytest.mark.parametrize("name", ["bad\nname", "x" * 10000])
248	def test_duplicate_name_errors_are_escaped_and_bounded(kind, name):
249	    item = (
250	        zvec.FieldSchema(name, zvec.DataType.INT32)
251	        if kind == "field"
252	        else zvec.VectorSchema(name, zvec.DataType.VECTOR_FP32, dimension=2)
253	    )
254	    with pytest.raises(ValueError) as exc_info:
255	        zvec.CollectionSchema("duplicates", **{kind + "s": [item, item]})
256	    message = str(exc_info.value)
257	    assert message.startswith("Invalid schema: duplicate")
258	    assert "\n" not in message
259	    assert len(message) < 256
260	    if "\n" in name:
261	        assert "\\n" in message
262	    else:
263	        assert "..." in message

import re

import pytest
import zvec


@pytest.fixture
def collection(tmp_path):
    schema = zvec.CollectionSchema(
        "validation", fields=zvec.FieldSchema("text", zvec.DataType.STRING)
    )
    coll = zvec.create_and_open(str(tmp_path / "collection"), schema)
    try:
        yield coll
    finally:
        coll.destroy()


@pytest.mark.parametrize("name", ["x", "ab", "集合 / 2026 🔎", "集" * 85 + "a"])
def test_collection_names_round_trip(tmp_path, name):
    path = str(tmp_path / "collection")
    schema = zvec.CollectionSchema(
        name, fields=zvec.FieldSchema("text", zvec.DataType.STRING)
    )
    coll = zvec.create_and_open(path, schema)
    try:
        assert coll.schema.name == name
        coll.close()
        coll = zvec.open(path)
        assert coll.schema.name == name
    finally:
        coll.close()


def test_document_ids_round_trip_without_normalization(collection):
    ids = [
        "user:123",
        "https://example.com/articles/42?a=b",
        "订单-2026-🙂",
        "界" * 341 + "a",  # 1024 UTF-8 bytes.
        "doc",
        " doc",
        "doc ",
        " ",
        "é",
        "e\u0301",
    ]
    text = "正文\nsecond line\tvalue"
    statuses = collection.insert(
        [zvec.Doc(id=doc_id, fields={"text": text}) for doc_id in ids]
    )
    assert all(status.ok() for status in statuses)
    collection.flush()
    fetched = collection.fetch(ids)

def test_falsey_alter_arguments_are_not_silently_ignored(tmp_path, invalid, argument):
    schema = zvec.CollectionSchema(
        "fields", fields=zvec.FieldSchema("value", zvec.DataType.INT32)
    )
    coll = zvec.create_and_open(str(tmp_path / "collection"), schema)
    try:
        assert coll.insert(zvec.Doc("doc", fields={"value": 42})).ok()
        kwargs = (
            {
                "new_name": invalid,
                "field_schema": zvec.FieldSchema("renamed", zvec.DataType.INT32),
            }
            if argument == "new_name"
            else {"new_name": "renamed", "field_schema": invalid}
        )
        with pytest.raises(TypeError, match="^Invalid schema:"):
            coll.alter_column("value", **kwargs)
        assert coll.schema.field("value") is not None
        assert coll.schema.field("renamed") is None
        assert coll.fetch("doc")["doc"].field("value") == 42
    finally:
        coll.destroy()


@pytest.mark.parametrize("kind", ["field", "vector"])
@pytest.mark.parametrize("name", ["bad\nname", "x" * 10000])
def test_duplicate_name_errors_are_escaped_and_bounded(kind, name):
    item = (
        zvec.FieldSchema(name, zvec.DataType.INT32)
        if kind == "field"
        else zvec.VectorSchema(name, zvec.DataType.VECTOR_FP32, dimension=2)
    )
    with pytest.raises(ValueError) as exc_info:
        zvec.CollectionSchema("duplicates", **{kind + "s": [item, item]})
    message = str(exc_info.value)
    assert message.startswith("Invalid schema: duplicate")
    assert "\n" not in message
    assert len(message) < 256
    if "\n" in name:
        assert "\\n" in message
    else:
        assert "..." in message
